HEX to RGB converter

Convert a HEX color to RGB or RGBA, inspect its channels and preview transparency. Switch to RGB input for the reverse conversion.

Channels: whole numbers from 0 to 255. Alpha: 0 to 1. HEX alpha is rounded to the nearest 8-bit value.

A LITTLE CONTEXT

How to convert HEX to RGB

Each pair of HEX digits represents one red, green or blue channel. Enter a color above to see its decimal channel values. A fourth channel controls opacity.

HEX pairs → decimal channels from 0 to 255

References: MDN: CSS HEX colors and alpha

Good to know

Can I use a 3-digit HEX color?

Yes. Each digit is repeated: #abc expands to #aabbcc, so its RGB values are 170, 187 and 204.

What do the last two digits mean?

In an 8-digit CSS HEX color, the last pair is alpha. 00 is fully transparent and FF is fully opaque. #33669980 has alpha 128/255, approximately 0.501961.

Why did my alpha value change slightly?

HEX alpha has 256 possible values. An RGB input alpha of 0.5 rounds to the byte 128, or 128/255. The preview and RGB output use that rounded value to match the generated HEX.

How many RGB colors are there?

With 8 bits for each red, green and blue channel, there are 256 × 256 × 256 = 16,777,216 opaque RGB combinations. Alpha adds opacity values; it is separate from those three channels.

Does this support every CSS color syntax?

This tool accepts HEX or separate numeric sRGB channels. Named colors, HSL, display-p3 and other CSS color spaces are outside this input format.

PRACTICAL REFERENCE

Short HEX, full HEX and alpha

These complete examples show the relationship between input notation and channel values.

HEX inputChannelsMeaning
#244cda36, 76, 218Opaque RGB
#abc170, 187, 204Short notation repeats each digit
#0f080, 255, 0; alpha 136/255Four-digit short notation includes alpha
#3366998051, 102, 153; alpha 128/255Eight-digit notation includes alpha

Alpha text is rounded to six decimal places; the byte fraction remains visible. This converter does not measure color contrast or guarantee accessible color combinations. For layout units, use PX to REM, REM to PX or the CSS unit guide.
